跟著做，套用到你的日常Do it. Then make it yours.

5 個真實業務情境，從讀檔、寫文件、跑數據到對外溝通，帶你看 Cowork 如何自己規劃、執行，並在每個對外動作前停下來等你核准。看完就動手，再換成你自己的工作。5 real business scenarios — from reading files and writing documents to crunching data and communicating outbound. 航空業 · 聯管中心Aviation · Operations Control

班機取消旅客安置優先序Who Gets Helped First When a Flight Cancels

⏱ 約 15–20 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~15–20 min · Level ★★★

班機取消，八位旅客要安置。這不是「該不該處理」的排除題，而是**「先處理誰」的排序題**。而排序最容易錯的地方，是把會員等級當成第一判準 —— 鑽石卡但沒有後續行程的旅客，時間壓力其實最低；經濟艙的單獨旅行孩童，照護責任卻最高。這個情境測的就是：它會不會被「VIP」兩個字帶著走。A flight cancels and eight passengers need rebooking. This is not a question of who qualifies — it is a question of **who goes first**. And the easiest way to get the order wrong is to treat loyalty tier as the primary criterion. A top-tier member with no onward connection is under the least time pressure of anyone on the list; an unaccompanied minor in economy carries the highest duty of care. What this scenario tests is whether the word "VIP" will pull it off course.

會用到的技能Skills usedOutlookExcelOneDrive Search

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是聯管中心的值班人員。班機取消的當下，所有旅客都在等，而你只有一組人力，必須決定先打哪一通電話。直覺會說先處理最高等級的客戶 —— 但那位鑽石卡旅客是終點站抵達，他今天晚一點走沒有連鎖影響；而那位十二歲單獨旅行的孩子後面還有一段轉機，沒人幫她改，她會卡在中轉站。這個情境把判斷基準寫成文件，讓 Cowork 照著排 —— 重點是理解**為什麼這樣排**。You are on duty in operations control. The moment a flight cancels, everyone is waiting and you have one team, so you must decide which call to make first. Instinct says start with the highest-tier customer — but that top-tier passenger terminates at the destination, and a later departure today has no knock-on effect for him. The twelve-year-old travelling alone has an onward connection, and if nobody rebooks it for her she is stranded at the transfer point. This scenario puts the criteria into a document and lets Cowork apply them — the point is understanding **why the order comes out the way it does**.

They are existing data that must be seeded into OneDrive and the mailbox before class. 🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

要求它寫出「依據哪一條」，不要只給結論Require the clause, not just the verdict

提示詞刻意要求「逐位旅客判定安置分級**並寫出所依據的條件**」。只給分級結果你無從驗證，寫出依據條文你才看得出它是套規則還是憑印象。這在有明確作業標準的情境裡是通用做法 —— **要它引用，不要它總結。**The prompt deliberately asks it to classify each passenger **and state the condition it relied on**. A bare tier tells you nothing you can verify; a cited clause shows whether it applied the rules or worked from impression. This is standard practice wherever a written operating standard exists — **ask it to cite, not to summarise.**

提示詞Prompt
請處理 SX802 航班取消的旅客安置。到我的信箱找出聯管中心的班機取消通知，並到 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/航空業/AIR1_航班異常 資料夾讀取受影響旅客清單與旅客安置優先序原則。請逐位旅客判定安置分級並寫出所依據的條件，依分級排出處理順序，擬定各自的安置方案，再草擬給旅客的個別通知信。所有通知先草擬，等我核准後才送出。Please handle passenger rebooking for the cancelled SX802. Find the operations-control cancellation notice in my mailbox, and read the affected passenger list and the rebooking priority principles in the Cowork_Lab/Aviation/AIR1_Disruption folder in OneDrive. Classify each passenger's priority tier and state the condition you relied on, order the handling accordingly, prepare each rebooking plan, then draft individual notifications to the passengers. Draft everything and wait for my approval before sending.
2

⭐ 四個最容易判錯的地方，它全部避開了⭐ Four traps in the list — and it walked past all of them

實測八位分級全對，其中四位是刻意設計的陷阱。**鑽石卡＋商務艙但終點站抵達 → Tier 4**，它引用原則原文「時間壓力最低」，沒有被會員等級帶走。**十二歲單獨旅行孩童，經濟艙、無會員等級 → Tier 1**，它明講「經濟艙的 UM 孩童仍是 Tier 1」，分級看的是需求不是票價。**他航轉機間隔 3h50m → Tier 2，優先於同航的 3h40m**，它主動解釋「雖然間隔比較長，但他航需人工協調，作業時間更長」。**鑽石卡且有轉機，但間隔 9h20m → Tier 4**，這位是干擾項：有轉機不代表急，間隔夠長就不急。最後統計 Tier 1 三位、Tier 2 一位、Tier 3 零位、Tier 4 四位，它還主動說明「本次無 Tier 3」並解釋原因。All eight tiers were correct, and four of them are deliberate traps. **Top-tier member in business class, but terminating at the destination → Tier 4.** It quoted the principle directly — lowest time pressure — and was not swayed by status. **Twelve-year-old unaccompanied minor, economy, no membership → Tier 1.** It stated explicitly that an unaccompanied minor in economy is still Tier 1; the tier reflects need, not fare. **Interline connection with a 3h50m gap → Tier 2, ahead of a same-carrier connection at 3h40m.** It volunteered the reason: the interline booking cannot be reissued in our own system and needs manual coordination, so it takes longer. **Top-tier member with an onward connection, but a 9h20m gap → Tier 4.** That one is the distractor: having a connection does not make it urgent if the interval is comfortable. The final count came to three in Tier 1, one in Tier 2, none in Tier 3 and four in Tier 4 — and it pointed out that Tier 3 was empty this time, with the reason why.

3

八封草稿，以及它不肯代填的兩件事Eight drafts — and two things it would not fill in

八封通知都存成草稿，主旨以「【草稿｜待核准】」開頭，方便你在草稿匣一眼認出。內容依旅客需求各自不同：單獨旅行孩童那封同時通知監護人與兩站地勤（依原則不得只寄給旅客本人）；醫療需求那封註明改簽班機須先完成氧氣瓶配置與醫療放行。⚠️ 兩個空格它明確拒絕代填：**替代班機的班號與時間** —— 信箱與檔案中都沒有當日替代班表，它留為 `[待訂位組確認後填入]`；**旅客的 Email 位址** —— 清單只提供電話，收件人欄位留空。在航班異常的場合，一個編出來的替代班機時間會讓旅客白跑機場。All eight notifications were saved as drafts, each subject prefixed "[Draft — pending approval]" so they are easy to spot in the folder. The contents differ by need: the unaccompanied-minor letter also goes to the guardian and to ground staff at both stations (the principles forbid sending only to the passenger); the medical-needs letter notes that any rebooking requires oxygen provisioning and medical clearance first. ⚠️ Two blanks it refused to fill: **the replacement flight number and time** — neither the mailbox nor the files contain that day's alternative schedule, so it left `[to be confirmed by reservations]`; and **passenger email addresses** — the list provides phone numbers only, so the recipient fields stay empty. During a disruption, an invented replacement flight time sends a passenger to the airport for nothing.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

八封通知都停在草稿匣，沒有任何一封被寄出。核准前建議依分級順序檢查，而不是照草稿匣的排列順序 —— Tier 1 那三封是最需要仔細看的，因為對象是孩童、醫療需求與行動不便旅客。特別檢查兩件事：單獨旅行孩童那封有沒有同時寄給監護人，以及替代班機資訊有沒有被人補上、還是仍是佔位符。**旅客資料含姓名、電話與行程，屬個人資料，草稿內容不應轉貼到其他管道。**All eight notifications remain in drafts and none was sent. Review them in tier order rather than the order they appear in the folder — the three Tier 1 letters deserve the closest reading, since they concern a child, a medical case and a passenger with reduced mobility. Check two things in particular: whether the unaccompanied-minor letter also addresses the guardian, and whether the replacement flight details have actually been supplied or are still placeholders. **Passenger records contain names, phone numbers and itineraries — personal data that should not be reposted to other channels.**

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 八位旅客都有分級，且每位都寫出所依據的條件All eight passengers are classified, each citing the condition relied upon
  • 鑽石卡但終點站抵達者被判為 Tier 4，未因會員等級提前The top-tier member terminating at the destination is Tier 4, not promoted by status
  • 經濟艙的單獨旅行孩童被判為 Tier 1，未因艙等降級The unaccompanied minor in economy is Tier 1, not demoted by cabin
  • 他航轉機者排在同航轉機者之前，且有說明原因The interline connection ranks ahead of the same-carrier connection, with the reason given
  • 轉機間隔超過四小時者未被誤判為緊急A connection with more than four hours' margin is not treated as urgent
  • 單獨旅行孩童的通知同時寄給監護人，未只寄給旅客本人The unaccompanied-minor notification also goes to the guardian, not only the passenger
  • 替代班機資訊未知時以佔位符標示，未自行編造班號或時間Unknown replacement flight details are placeholders, with no invented flight numbers or times
  • 八封通知都停留在草稿匣，沒有任何一封被寄出All eight notifications remain in drafts and none was sent

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把原則裡的四級改成你們自己的旅客照護分級，測試同一套流程。Replace the four tiers with your own duty-of-care levels and test the same flow.
  • 加入一份當日替代班表，看它能不能直接把班號填進安置方案。Add that day's alternative schedule and see whether it can fill flight numbers into the plans.
  • 增加旅客人數到三十位，觀察分級與排序在規模放大後是否仍然穩定。Scale the list to thirty passengers and see whether the tiering holds up.

航空業 · 組員派遣Aviation · Crew Scheduling

組員飛時限制四維度檢查Four Independent Limits, One Crew List

⏱ 約 10–15 分鐘 · 難度 ★★☆⏱ ~10–15 min · Level ★★☆

飛時限制不是一條線，是四條各自獨立的線：月累計、近七日滾動、兩段執勤間休息、單日執勤時數。任一條超限就是違規。難的地方在於**它們會互相掩護** —— 月累計最高的人可能完全合規，月累計最低的人反而因為近七日過度集中而超標，而所有時數都漂亮的人可能因為紅眼航班後接早班，休息差了三十分鐘。再加一層：**目前合規不等於安全**，還要看月底會不會超標。Flight-time limits are not one line but four independent ones: monthly cumulative, seven-day rolling, minimum rest between duties, and single-day duty. Breaching any one is a breach. The difficulty is that **they mask each other** — the crew member with the highest monthly total may be entirely compliant, while the one with the lowest breaches the rolling limit through a concentrated week, and someone whose hours all look fine falls thirty minutes short on rest after a red-eye into an early. Then a further layer: **compliant today is not the same as safe**, because the month-end projection matters too.

會用到的技能Skills usedExcelAutomationAnalysis

🎯情境背景Scenario

你在派遣室，每天早上要確認今天的班表沒有踩到飛時限制。這件事用眼睛看很容易漏，因為四個維度要分別算，而且其中兩個（近七日滾動、兩段執勤間休息）需要跨日期計算。更麻煩的是「現在合規但月底會爆」這種情況 —— 等到真的超標才發現，已經來不及調整派遣了。這個情境把四個維度交給規則文件，每天照同一套邏輯跑一次。You work in crew scheduling and check every morning that today's roster does not breach flight-time limits. Doing this by eye is error-prone: four dimensions must be computed separately, and two of them — the rolling window and minimum rest — require cross-date arithmetic. Worse is the case that is compliant now but will breach by month end; by the time it actually breaches, there is no room left to re-crew. This scenario hands the four dimensions to a rules document and runs the same logic every morning.

🧰課前環境準備Pre-class setup

  • 📎AIR2_組員飛時彙總.xlsxAIR2_組員飛時彙總.xlsx十位組員的月累計飛時、近七日飛時、執勤起訖時間與月底剩餘已排班時數Ten crew members with monthly hours, seven-day hours, duty start/end times and remaining rostered hours
  • 📎AIR2_FTL檢查規則.mdAIR2_FTL檢查規則.md四個維度的上限與檢查窗口、前瞻預測算法，以及四個最容易漏掉的地方The four limits and their windows, the projection formula, and the four things most often missed

⚠️ 這些不是上課時拖進聊天框的附件，而是課前就要放進 OneDrive 與信箱的既有資料。進階情境示範的正是 Cowork 自己去撈、自己跨 App 執行；素材若靠人貼進對話，就退回成 Copilot Chat 也做得到的事了。完整步驟見離線包的〈課前環境準備指南〉。⚠️ These are not chat attachments. They are existing data that must be seeded into OneDrive and the mailbox before class. The advanced scenarios demonstrate Cowork finding the material itself and acting across apps; if a human pastes it into the conversation, it collapses back into something Copilot Chat can already do. See the pre-class setup guide in the offline pack for the full procedure.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

要求四個維度分開列，並且做前瞻預測Ask for the four dimensions separately — and for the projection

提示詞有兩個關鍵要求。一是「四個維度的違規名單**分開列，不要混在一起**」—— 混在一起你會看不出哪個維度出問題，也無法針對性處置：休息不足要換人，近七日超標要暫停排班，兩者的處置完全不同。二是「務必做前瞻預測」—— 這是這個情境最有價值的部分，因為只看現況的檢查，永遠只能事後補救。Two requirements matter in the prompt. First, the four dimensions must be **listed separately, not merged** — merged, you cannot see which limit was breached, and the remedies differ entirely: insufficient rest means swapping the crew member out, a rolling-window breach means suspending further rostering. Second, the projection is mandatory — this is the most valuable part of the scenario, because a check that only looks at today can only ever react.

提示詞Prompt
請做今天的組員飛時 FTL 檢查。到 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/航空業/AIR2_組員派遣 資料夾讀取組員飛時彙總與 FTL 檢查規則，依規則的四個維度逐一檢查全部組員。請把四個維度的違規名單分開列，不要混在一起；每筆違規寫明組員、違反哪一項、實際值 vs 上限、超出多少。另外務必依規則做前瞻預測，列出目前合規但月底將超標者與預估值。最後給我一句話結論：今天最該處理的一件事。Please run today's crew flight-time limit check. Read the crew hours summary and the FTL check rules in the Cowork_Lab/Aviation/AIR2_Crew folder in OneDrive, and check every crew member against all four dimensions. List the breaches for each dimension separately, not merged; for each one state the crew member, which limit was breached, actual versus cap, and by how much. Also perform the forward projection the rules require, listing anyone compliant today who will breach by month end, with the projected figure. Finish with a one-sentence conclusion: the single most important thing to deal with today.
2

⭐ 四個維度、三種違規、各中一人，而且互不重疊⭐ Four dimensions, three breaches, three different people

實測結果值得逐條看，因為每一條都在示範一種不同的誤判。**近七日超標**：某位座艙長 62 小時超過 60 小時上限，而他的月累計只有 72 小時，看起來非常安全 —— 它主動引用規則說「月累計安全不代表沒問題」。**休息不足**：某位空服員休息 9.5 小時，短少 30 分鐘。她的月累計 65、近七日 39，所有時數維度都合規，純粹是紅眼航班後接早班造成的。**前瞻預警**：某位機長目前 88 小時完全合規，但月底前還有三趟長程共 14 小時，預估 102 小時 → 超標。而最有意思的是**沒有違規的那一位**：月累計最高的 95.5 小時，月底只剩一趟短程 3 小時，預估 98.5 → 仍然合規。它還補了一句「僅剩 1.5 小時餘裕，若臨時加派即破線」，把她列為零餘裕名單。**排行榜第一名不是違規者，這正是逐人套規則和看排序的差別。**Each finding demonstrates a different kind of misjudgement, so walk through them one at a time. **Rolling-window breach**: a purser at 62 hours against a 60-hour cap — while his monthly total of 72 looks entirely safe. It quoted the rule back: a safe monthly figure does not mean there is no problem. **Insufficient rest**: a cabin crew member with 9.5 hours, thirty minutes short. Her monthly 65 and seven-day 39 are both fine; the breach comes purely from a red-eye followed by an early. **Forward warning**: a captain at 88 hours today, fully compliant, with three long-haul rotations totalling 14 hours still rostered — projecting to 102 hours and a breach. The most interesting entry is the one that is **not** a breach: the highest monthly total on the list, 95.5 hours, with only a single 3-hour sector left, projecting to 98.5 and remaining compliant. It added that this leaves just 1.5 hours of margin and any ad-hoc assignment would break it, placing her on a zero-margin watch list. **The top of the leaderboard is not the offender — which is exactly the difference between applying rules per person and reading a ranking.**

3

⭐ 第四個維度它說「無法檢查」，而不是「合規」⭐ On the fourth dimension it said "cannot check", not "compliant"

這一點是整個情境最值得帶走的。規則要求檢查四個維度，但彙總表裡**根本沒有「單日執勤時數」這個欄位**。它沒有跳過，也沒有把這一項算成通過，而是明確寫：「這一項今天是空白，**不是合規**」，並建議請派遣室補上該欄位。請把這句話當成教材重點：**「查不到」和「沒問題」是兩回事。**一份把缺漏欄位默默算成合規的檢查報告，比沒做還危險，因為它會讓人以為已經檢查過了。這也提醒我們：交出去的資料完不完整，決定了檢查的有效範圍。This is the most transferable lesson in the scenario. The rules require four dimensions, but the summary sheet **contains no single-day duty column at all**. It neither skipped the dimension nor scored it as a pass. It wrote plainly that this dimension is blank today, **which is not the same as compliant**, and recommended that scheduling add the column. Take that sentence as the headline: **"cannot verify" and "no problem" are different statements.** A check that quietly scores missing data as compliant is more dangerous than no check at all, because it leaves people believing the work was done. It also reminds us that the completeness of the data you hand over defines the scope within which any check is meaningful.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

這個情境的產出是一份內部檢查報告，不會直接對外，因此不會出現核准卡。但規則文件裡有一條值得注意的送出規定：**檢查結果寄給自己與派遣室主管，不要直接通知組員本人** —— 因為派遣調整須先經主管確認，直接通知組員會造成混亂。實測時它遵守了這條，並主動詢問派遣室主管是誰。另外提醒：組員飛時屬於人事與適航合規資料，報告不應轉貼到公開頻道。The output here is an internal check report with no outbound action, so no approval cards appear. But the rules document contains a distribution rule worth noting: **send the results to yourself and the scheduling manager, not directly to the crew members**, because roster changes need managerial sign-off first and notifying crew directly creates confusion. It observed that rule in the live run and asked who the scheduling manager is. Note also that crew hours are HR and airworthiness-compliance data, and the report should not be reposted to open channels.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 四個維度的結果分開呈現，未混成一份清單The four dimensions are reported separately rather than merged into one list
  • 每筆違規都寫明實際值、上限與超出多少Every breach states the actual value, the cap and the margin by which it was exceeded
  • 月累計安全但近七日超標者有被抓出來The crew member who is safe monthly but breaches the rolling window is identified
  • 所有時數合規但休息不足者有被抓出來The crew member whose hours are all fine but whose rest falls short is identified
  • ⭐ 前瞻預測有做，列出目前合規但月底將超標者與預估值⭐ The forward projection was performed, listing who will breach by month end and the projected figure
  • 時數最高者未被直接當成違規者，判定依實際規則而非排序The highest-hours crew member is not assumed to be the offender; the verdict follows the rules, not the ranking
  • ⭐ 資料缺漏的維度被標為「無法檢查」，未被當成合規⭐ The dimension with missing data is marked "cannot check" rather than scored as compliant
  • 結論明確指出今天最該處理的一件事，而非列出一堆待辦The conclusion names one thing to deal with today rather than listing everything

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把上限值改成你們適用的法規或公司政策，只改規則文件。Change the caps to your applicable regulation or company policy by editing only the rules document.
  • 補上「單日執勤時數」欄位，讓第四個維度也能真的檢查。Add the single-day duty column so the fourth dimension can actually be checked.
  • 做成每天早上自動執行的排程任務，結果寄給自己與主管。Turn it into a scheduled task each morning, mailing the result to yourself and your manager.
🛠️
航空業 · 機坪安全Aviation · Ramp Safety

機坪事件：Teams 被提及自動接手Ramp Safety: Triggered by a Teams Mention

⏱ 約 20–25 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~20–25 min · Level ★★★

前面的觸發任務都是收信啟動，這一個換了觸發源：**在 Teams 被 @提及**。而事件本身是全教材最容易判錯的一個 —— 通報寫著「輕微擦撞、無人受傷」，聽起來可以當場結案，但只要航機有實體損傷，最低就是應通報主管機關的等級。更關鍵的是：**這件事真正的嚴重性，不在這則訊息裡** —— 要回頭查同一架飛機近九十天的紀錄才看得出來。The earlier triggers all woke on an incoming email; this one changes the source: **being @mentioned in Teams**. And the incident itself is the easiest misjudgement in the whole course — the report says "minor contact, no injuries", which sounds like something to close on the spot, yet any physical damage to the aircraft makes it a reportable occurrence at minimum. More importantly: **the real severity is not in that message at all** — it only becomes visible by going back through ninety days of history for that same aircraft.

會用到的技能Skills usedAutomationEvent TriggerTeamsOutlook

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是機坪安全的窗口。地面作業事件通常在 Teams 群組裡被提及，而通報的人多半是現場人員，習慣用「輕微」「沒事」這種口語描述。問題是分級標準看的不是描述聽起來嚴不嚴重，是**航機有沒有損傷**；而升級規則看的更不是這一件，是**同一架飛機最近發生過幾件**。這兩件事都不會出現在通報訊息裡，必須自己去查。You handle ramp safety. Ground occurrences are usually raised in a Teams group, and the person reporting is typically on the apron, describing things colloquially — "minor", "nothing serious". But the classification standard does not care how the description sounds; it cares **whether the aircraft was damaged**. And the escalation rule cares even less about this occurrence in isolation — it cares **how many the same aircraft has had recently**. Neither fact appears in the report; both have to be looked up.

🧰課前環境準備Pre-class setup

  • 📎AIR3_機坪安全事件分級與通報SOP.mdAIR3_機坪安全事件分級與通報SOP.mdA/B/C/D 四級標準、兩個最容易判錯的地方、升級規則與七項必含內容The A/B/C/D standard, the two commonest misjudgements, the escalation rules and seven mandatory elements
  • 📎AIR3_機坪安全事件紀錄.xlsxAIR3_機坪安全事件紀錄.xlsx近三個月的機坪事件紀錄，含機尾號、站別、事件類型與分級 —— 升級判定的依據Three months of ramp occurrences with tail number, station, type and grade — the basis for the escalation decision
  • 📎AIR3_觸發測試貼文.mdAIR3_觸發測試貼文.md⚠️ 觸發測試貼文 —— 要由真人在 Teams 頻道手動輸入並用 @ 真正提及自己⚠️ The trigger test post — a real person must type it in Teams and genuinely @mention themselves

⚠️ 這些不是上課時拖進聊天框的附件，而是課前就要放進 OneDrive 與信箱的既有資料。進階情境示範的正是 Cowork 自己去撈、自己跨 App 執行；素材若靠人貼進對話，就退回成 Copilot Chat 也做得到的事了。完整步驟見離線包的〈課前環境準備指南〉。⚠️ These are not chat attachments. They are existing data that must be seeded into OneDrive and the mailbox before class. The advanced scenarios demonstrate Cowork finding the material itself and acting across apps; if a human pastes it into the conversation, it collapses back into something Copilot Chat can already do. See the pre-class setup guide in the offline pack for the full procedure.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

建立 @提及觸發任務：它必須綁定一個特定頻道Create the mention trigger — it must be bound to one specific channel

這一步會遇到一個**設計上必須先知道的限制**：Teams 的 @提及觸發**無法整個 Teams 全域監看，必須綁定特定一個聊天或頻道**。實測時它先嘗試全域設定、失敗，接著列出所有團隊與頻道尋找合適的目標，找不到之後**停下來反問要監看哪一個**，並給出四個具體選項，而不是隨便挑一個綁上去。因此課前準備時**請先在 Teams 建好要監看的頻道**，現場才不會多出一段建頻道的流程。This step runs into a **constraint worth knowing before you design anything**: a Teams mention trigger **cannot watch Teams globally — it must be bound to one specific chat or channel**. In the live run it first attempted a tenant-wide setup, which failed, then listed every team and channel looking for a suitable target, and on finding none **stopped and asked which to watch**, offering four concrete options rather than binding itself to an arbitrary one. So **create the channel you intend to watch before class**, and the session will not detour into channel creation.

提示詞Prompt
請建立一個事件觸發任務：當我在 Teams 的「機坪安全通報」頻道被 @提及時自動執行。執行內容是讀取 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/航空業/AIR3_機坪安全 底下的機坪安全事件分級與通報 SOP，依 SOP 判定該機坪事件的等級。特別注意兩件事：一是只要航機有任何實體損傷最低即為 C 級，不得因為無人受傷或描述輕微就判 D 級；二是必須到同資料夾的機坪安全事件紀錄查詢同一機尾號近 90 天的事件件數，達 3 件以上一律升為 B 級。通報內容要含七項必含事項，其中同機尾號查詢結果即使為 0 也要寫出。最後草擬給機坪安全主管的信。未知事項寫調查中，不要臆測。所有通報先草擬，等我核准後才送出。Please create an event-triggered task that runs when I am @mentioned in the ramp safety Teams channel. When it fires, read the ramp safety classification and notification SOP under Cowork_Lab/Aviation/AIR3_Ramp_Safety in OneDrive and classify the occurrence per that SOP. Two things need particular attention: any physical damage to the aircraft makes it at least a C-grade occurrence, and it must never be downgraded to D because nobody was hurt or the description sounds minor; and you must query the ramp occurrence log in the same folder for the number of events on the same tail number in the previous 90 days, escalating to B if there are three or more. The notification must contain all seven mandatory elements, including the same-tail query result even when it is zero. Finally draft an email to the ramp safety manager. Write "under investigation" for anything unknown rather than guessing. Draft all notifications and wait for my approval.
2

確認觸發器綁定的是頻道訊息，並進入待命Confirm the trigger is bound to channel messages and armed

觸發器建立後，設定卡會顯示觸發類型是「Teams 頻道訊息送達」，而任務摘要會寫成「當該頻道中 @提及您時自動執行」。⚠️ **測試務必由真人在 Teams 手動輸入並用 @ 真正提及自己。**請 Cowork 代為張貼是行不通的 —— 工具張貼出來的「@某某」只是純文字，不構成 Teams 原生的提及標記，觸發器不會判定為被提及。實測時它自己也發現了這一點，並事先說明而不是假裝成功。Once created, the setup card shows the trigger type as a Teams channel message, and the task summary reads that it runs when you are mentioned in that channel. ⚠️ **The test must be typed by a real person in Teams, genuinely @mentioning themselves.** Asking Cowork to post it for you will not work — an "@name" posted through the tool is plain text and does not constitute a native Teams mention, so the trigger will not recognise it. It discovered this itself in the live run and said so up front rather than pretending otherwise.

3

⭐ 判定：C 級不是 D 級，而且要升到 B 級⭐ The verdict: not D but C — and then escalated to B

這是本情境的核心，判定分兩段，兩個陷阱都避開了。**第一段，基礎分級 C 級。** 訊息寫「輕微擦撞、無人受傷」，聽起來像 D 級，但 D 級的條件是「無人員傷害**且無航機損傷**」，而本案蒙皮有 15 公分刮痕與凹陷。它引用 SOP 原文：「判定依據是航機有無損傷，不是描述聽起來嚴不嚴重」。**第二段，查歷史後升為 B 級。** 它到事件紀錄查同一機尾號近 90 天，找出三件（六月、七月、八月各一件），達到「90 天內累計 3 件以上一律升 B 級」的門檻，因此通報時限從 24 小時縮為 2 小時，並須啟動該站地面作業專案檢討。**這三件事完全沒有出現在通報訊息裡。**它還多檢查了兩條我們沒特別提醒的升級規則：同站別 30 天同類型（只有 2 件，未達門檻）與燃油洩漏（無）。This is the heart of the scenario, decided in two stages, with both traps avoided. **Stage one, base grade C.** The message says "minor contact, no injuries", which sounds like D — but D requires no injury **and no aircraft damage**, and here the skin has a 15-centimetre scrape and a dent. It quoted the SOP directly: the criterion is whether the aircraft was damaged, not how serious the description sounds. **Stage two, escalated to B on history.** It queried the occurrence log for the same tail number over 90 days and found three events, one each in June, July and August, meeting the "three or more in 90 days escalates to B" threshold. The reporting deadline therefore tightens from 24 hours to 2, and a station-level ground operations review must be opened. **None of those three events appears anywhere in the report message.** It also checked two escalation rules we had not specifically flagged: same-station same-type within 30 days (only two, below threshold) and fuel spillage (none).

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

通報信停在草稿、Teams 回覆也只是顯示全文等你確認，沒有任何一則被自動送出。核准前請特別確認兩件事：**最終等級是 B 而不是 C**（升級規則有沒有生效），以及**同機尾號查詢結果有沒有被寫進通報**（即使是 0 件也要寫）。後者是這份 SOP 刻意的要求 —— 寫出「近 90 天 0 件」和沒寫，對讀通報的人是完全不同的資訊。示範結束後記得到自動化頁面把觸發任務暫停。The notification email stops at draft and the Teams reply is only shown to you for confirmation; nothing was sent automatically. Two things to confirm before approving: **that the final grade is B rather than C**, meaning the escalation rule actually fired, and **that the same-tail query result appears in the notification**, even when it is zero. The latter is a deliberate requirement of this SOP — writing "zero occurrences in the past 90 days" and omitting the line entirely convey completely different things to whoever reads it. Pause the trigger on the Automations page when the demo is done.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 觸發器綁定在指定的 Teams 頻道上，並確認進入待命狀態The trigger is bound to the intended Teams channel and confirmed armed
  • 測試訊息由真人在 Teams 手動輸入並用 @ 真正提及自己The test message was typed by a real person with a genuine @mention
  • 基礎分級為 C 級，未因「無人受傷／描述輕微」而降為 D 級The base grade is C and was not downgraded to D because nobody was hurt or the wording sounded minor
  • 有回頭查詢同一機尾號近 90 天的事件件數The same tail number's occurrences over the previous 90 days were actually queried
  • 查出 3 件後依升級規則升為 B 級，通報時限縮短Finding three occurrences escalated the grade to B and tightened the reporting deadline
  • 同機尾號查詢結果被寫進通報，即使為 0 件也有寫出The same-tail query result appears in the notification, stated even when zero
  • 七項必含事項齊備，未知事項寫「調查中」而非臆測All seven mandatory elements are present, with unknowns marked under investigation
  • 通報信停留在草稿，Teams 回覆未自動張貼The notification remains a draft and the Teams reply was not posted automatically

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把分級標準換成你們的地安事件分級表，測試同一套流程。Swap in your own ground-occurrence grading table and test the same flow.
  • 在事件紀錄裡多加幾筆同機尾號的事件，觀察升級判定是否跟著改變。Add more occurrences on the same tail number and watch the escalation decision change.
  • 把觸發源改成收信，比較兩種觸發源在設定與限制上的差別。Switch the trigger source to email and compare the setup and constraints of the two.

航空業 · 航線規劃Aviation · Network Planning

季度航線績效檢討簡報A Quarterly Review Deck, in Your Own Brand

⏱ 約 20–30 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~20–30 min · Level ★★★

前面所有情境的產出都是文字、信件或分析報告；這一個**真的生出一份簡報**，而且套用公司品牌範本 —— 主題色、字型、Logo、版面配置全部繼承，Cowork 只改寫文字內容，不動設計。至於分析本身，這個情境要示範一件反直覺的事：**營收最高的航線，往往不是最賺錢的那條。**Every earlier scenario produced text, letters or a report; this one **actually produces a deck** — and applies your corporate template, inheriting theme colours, fonts, logo and layouts. Cowork rewrites the words and leaves the design alone. As for the analysis, this scenario demonstrates something counter-intuitive: **the route with the highest revenue is usually not the one making the most money.**

會用到的技能Skills usedPowerPointExcel品牌範本 Brand Template

🎯情境背景Scenario

你負責航線規劃，每季要向管理層報告八條航線的績效。最容易犯的錯是照營收排名做結論 —— 長程線營收金額大，但用大機型飛長航段，直接營運成本同樣龐大；中短程線營收金額不起眼，單位成本低、客公里收益高，扣完成本反而留下更多。還有第三個陷阱：載客率很高但客公里收益很低，代表是靠低價把座位賣光 —— 座位滿了，錢沒賺到。You run network planning and report on eight routes to management each quarter. The commonest error is drawing conclusions from the revenue ranking. Long-haul routes generate large revenue figures, but flying wide-bodies over long sectors carries correspondingly large direct operating costs. Short and medium-haul routes look unremarkable on revenue, yet their unit costs are lower and yields higher, so more survives the cost line. There is a third trap: a very high load factor with a very low yield means seats were filled by discounting — full aircraft, thin margins.

  • 📎AIR4_季度航線績效簡報製作規則.mdAIR4_季度航線績效簡報製作規則.md品牌範本的使用方式、三個分析陷阱、簡報六頁結構與語氣限制How to use the brand template, three analytical traps, the six-slide structure and tone constraints
  • 📎華翔航空_簡報範本.potx華翔航空_簡報範本.potx⚠️ 品牌範本 —— **必須放在 OneDrive 根目錄，不能放子資料夾**，否則 Cowork 找不到⚠️ The brand template — **must sit in the OneDrive root, not a subfolder**, or Cowork will not find it

⚠️ 這些不是上課時拖進聊天框的附件，而是課前就要放進 OneDrive 與信箱的既有資料。進階情境示範的正是 Cowork 自己去撈、自己跨 App 執行；素材若靠人貼進對話，就退回成 Copilot Chat 也做得到的事了。完整步驟見離線包的〈課前環境準備指南〉。⚠️ These are not chat attachments. They are existing data that must be seeded into OneDrive and the mailbox before class. The advanced scenarios demonstrate Cowork finding the material itself and acting across apps; if a human pastes it into the conversation, it collapses back into something Copilot Chat can already do. 🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

⚠️ 品牌範本要放 OneDrive 根目錄，這一步最常出錯⚠️ The template goes in the OneDrive root — the commonest setup mistake

這是本情境唯一需要事前確認的環境設定：**個人品牌範本的 .potx 只能放 OneDrive 的根目錄，不能放進任何子資料夾。**放錯位置不會報錯，只會安靜地退回預設樣式 —— 你會拿到一份格式正確但完全沒有品牌的簡報，而且不容易第一時間看出原因。另外提醒：品牌範本功能**只支援 PowerPoint**，Word 與 Excel 不在範圍內。若某次不想套範本，明確說「不要使用品牌範本」即可。This is the one environment detail to verify beforehand: **a personal brand template must sit in the OneDrive root, never in a subfolder.** Getting it wrong produces no error — it silently falls back to the default theme, and you receive a well-formed deck with no branding at all, without an obvious reason why. Note also that brand templates apply to **PowerPoint only**; Word and Excel are out of scope. If you want a plain deck on a particular occasion, simply say so explicitly.

提示詞Prompt
請製作季度航線績效檢討簡報。到 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/航空業/AIR4_航線績效 資料夾讀取季度航線績效數據與簡報製作規則，依規則的六頁結構產出簡報。請務必套用我 OneDrive 根目錄的華翔航空_簡報範本.potx 品牌範本。分析時請特別依規則注意：營收最高的航線不一定最賺錢、載客率高不等於績效好。第四頁要並列營收排行與獲利排行並說明為何不同。完成後把簡報存到 OneDrive。Please build the quarterly route performance review deck. Read the quarterly route data and the deck production rules in the Cowork_Lab/Aviation/AIR4_Route_Performance folder in OneDrive, and produce the deck following the six-slide structure in the rules. Be sure to apply the brand template that sits in my OneDrive root. In the analysis, follow the rules on the highest-revenue route not necessarily being the most profitable, and a high load factor not meaning good performance. Slide four must place the revenue ranking beside the profitability ranking and explain why they differ. Save the finished deck to OneDrive.
2

⭐ 三個結論，每一個都和直覺相反⭐ Three findings, each against instinct

實測的分析結果值得逐條看。**營收第一 ≠ 獲利第一。** TPE-LAX 營收 328.4 百萬元全網第一，但貢獻毛利率只有 8.2%，倒數第二 —— 成本吃掉了營收的 91.8%，只留下 26.9 百萬元。**真正該加班的是誰。** TPE-SIN 營收只有 132.4 百萬元，貢獻毛利卻有 29.7 百萬元、毛利率 22.4%，**金額與比率同時勝過營收冠軍**。它給的原因很清楚：長程線用大機型飛長航段堆出營收金額，直接營運成本同樣龐大；中短程線單位成本低、客公里收益高。**載客率最高的那條反而要檢討票價。** TPE-BKK 載客率 88.5% 全網最高，但客公里收益 2.34 元全網最低、毛利率僅 11.5% —— 典型的量價失衡，應檢討票價與艙等組合而非增班。第四頁的標題它下得很好，可以直接當教材金句：**「營收排行與獲利排行幾乎相反：規模大不等於賺得多」。**The findings are worth taking one at a time. **Highest revenue is not highest profit.** TPE-LAX leads the network on revenue at 328.4 million, yet its contribution margin is 8.2%, second from bottom — costs absorb 91.8% of revenue, leaving 26.9 million. **Which route actually deserves more capacity.** TPE-SIN generates only 132.4 million in revenue, but contributes 29.7 million at a 22.4% margin — **beating the revenue leader on both the absolute figure and the ratio**. Its explanation is clear: long-haul builds revenue by flying wide-bodies over long sectors, and the direct costs scale with it; short and medium-haul carry lower unit costs and higher yields. **The fullest aircraft is the one needing a pricing review.** TPE-BKK has the network's highest load factor at 88.5%, yet the lowest yield at 2.34 and a margin of just 11.5% — textbook volume-price imbalance, calling for a fare and cabin-mix review rather than added frequency. Its own headline for slide four makes a good line to quote: **"The revenue ranking and the profit ranking are almost inverted: scale is not the same as earnings."**

3

檢查簡報：範本有沒有真的套上、示範頁有沒有清掉Check the deck: did the template apply, and were the sample slides removed

請實際打開 OneDrive 裡的簡報檔，不要只看對話裡的摘要。三個檢查點：**一、品牌有沒有繼承** —— 主題深藍與金色、品牌字型、母片上的識別是否都在。**二、示範頁有沒有清掉** —— 範本裡本來有三張示範用的空白版面，實測它自動把那三張刪掉，最終剛好六頁。這一步沒有人要求它做。**三、數字有沒有對得上** —— 抽兩條航線自己驗算貢獻毛利率，確認簡報上的百分比與原始數據一致。另外它產出後主動草擬了季度檢討會議，但因為目錄查不到航線規劃與收益管理的對應人員，只草擬不建立，並要求補上與會者名單。Open the deck in OneDrive rather than trusting the summary in the conversation. Three checks. **One, did the branding carry through** — theme navy and gold, the brand typeface, and the identity elements on the master. **Two, were the sample slides cleared** — the template ships with three placeholder layouts, and it removed all three automatically, leaving exactly six. Nobody asked it to. **Three, do the numbers reconcile** — pick two routes and recompute the contribution margin yourself against the source data. It also drafted a quarterly review meeting afterwards, but since the directory contains no matching network-planning or revenue-management contacts, it only drafted it rather than creating it, and asked for the attendee list.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

產出簡報並存入 OneDrive 屬於內部產出，不會觸發核准卡；只有後續要寄出或排會議時才進入核准流程。實測時它因為查不到與會者而**只草擬會議、沒有建立** —— 這是對的做法，因為建立會議會實際發信佔用別人的時間。簡報本身要人工複核的是數字與結論：**AI 產出的是初稿，不是定稿。**尤其這份簡報的結論會影響航線資源配置，送進管理層會議之前，請自己驗算過關鍵數字。Producing the deck and saving it to OneDrive is internal output and raises no approval card; approval applies only when you go on to send it or schedule a meeting. Because the directory held no matching attendees, it **drafted the meeting rather than creating it** — which is right, since creating one genuinely emails people and takes their time. What needs human review in the deck itself is the figures and the conclusions: **what an AI produces is a first draft, not a final one.** These conclusions will drive capacity decisions, so recompute the critical numbers yourself before this reaches a management meeting.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 簡報確實套用品牌範本，主題色、字型與母片識別都有繼承The deck genuinely applies the brand template, inheriting theme colours, fonts and master identity
  • 範本原有的示範頁已被移除，最終頁數符合規則要求The template's sample slides were removed and the final slide count matches the rules
  • 第四頁並列營收排行與獲利排行，並說明兩者為何不同Slide four places the revenue and profit rankings side by side and explains the divergence
  • 營收最高的航線因毛利率偏低而被列入檢討，未因營收第一而被讚揚The highest-revenue route is flagged for review on margin rather than praised for its revenue
  • 毛利率最高的航線被正確識別為最值得加班者The highest-margin route is correctly identified as the one deserving more capacity
  • 載客率最高但客公里收益最低者被判為量價失衡，建議檢討票價而非增班The highest-load-factor, lowest-yield route is identified as volume-price imbalance, recommending a fare review rather than more frequency
  • 簡報中的數字與原始數據一致，抽驗兩條航線可對得上The figures in the deck reconcile with the source data on a spot-check of two routes
  • 與會者查不到時只草擬會議、未逕行建立With no attendees resolvable, the meeting was drafted rather than created

  • 換成你們公司的 .potx 品牌範本，確認品牌元素有正確繼承。Swap in your own corporate .potx and confirm the branding carries through correctly.

把安全判定寫成有紅線的技能A Skill With Lines It Will Not Cross

⏱ 約 15–20 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~15–20 min · Level ★★★

把 AIR3 的機坪安全判定寫成自訂技能。但安全領域的技能和一般技能有個根本差異：一般技能出錯只是產出品質不好，安全技能出錯是**把應該通報的事件當場結案**。所以這個情境的重點不在觸發詞寫得漂不漂亮，而在**防護欄夠不夠硬** —— 哪些情況下它必須拒絕自己下判斷、把事情交回給人。This turns AIR3's ramp safety judgement into a custom skill. But a safety skill differs fundamentally from an ordinary one: when an ordinary skill errs, the output is poor; when a safety skill errs, **a reportable occurrence gets closed on the spot**. So the focus here is not elegant trigger phrasing but **how hard the guardrails are** — the circumstances in which it must refuse to decide and hand the matter back to a human.

會用到的技能Skills used自訂技能 SkillSkill Report

🎯情境背景Scenario

你已經在 AIR3 用過一次分級邏輯。把它寫成技能之後，任何同事在任何對話裡描述一件機坪事件，都會套用同一套標準 —— 這正是價值所在，也正是風險所在。因為技能會被複製到每一個人身上，**一條寫鬆的防護欄，會被標準化地複製成每個人的判斷習慣。**這個情境要練的，是把「什麼時候不准自己決定」寫清楚。You already used this grading logic once in AIR3. As a skill, any colleague describing a ramp occurrence in any conversation will have the same standard applied — which is precisely the value, and precisely the risk. Because the skill propagates to everyone, **a loosely written guardrail is standardised into everyone's judgement.** What this scenario practises is stating clearly when it is not allowed to decide for itself.

🧰課前環境準備Pre-class setup

  • 📎AIR5_SKILL.mdAIR5_SKILL_EN.md課後對照用的參考答案：含 frontmatter、Safety Red Lines 段落、scope 邊界與輸出格式The reference answer for post-class comparison: frontmatter, a Safety Red Lines section, scope boundaries and output format
  • 📎AIR3_機坪安全事件分級與通報SOP.mdAIR3_機坪安全事件分級與通報SOP.md技能要寫進去的來源規則（沿用 AIR3 的分級 SOP）The source rules the skill encodes (reusing AIR3's grading SOP)

⚠️ 這些不是上課時拖進聊天框的附件，而是課前就要放進 OneDrive 與信箱的既有資料。進階情境示範的正是 Cowork 自己去撈、自己跨 App 執行；素材若靠人貼進對話，就退回成 Copilot Chat 也做得到的事了。完整步驟見離線包的〈課前環境準備指南〉。⚠️ These are not chat attachments. They are existing data that must be seeded into OneDrive and the mailbox before class. The advanced scenarios demonstrate Cowork finding the material itself and acting across apps; if a human pastes it into the conversation, it collapses back into something Copilot Chat can already do. See the pre-class setup guide in the offline pack for the full procedure.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

把「不准自己決定」的四種情況寫進提示詞Write the four "do not decide alone" cases into the prompt

這個提示詞和 TEL5 的差別在重心。TEL5 重視「不要和其他技能搶觸發」，這裡重視「不要越權判斷」。四條紅線都是**限制它的自由**，而不是擴充它的能力：航機有損傷一律 C 級起跳、必查同機尾號 90 天、資訊不足一律升級給值班主管、機尾號缺漏就不准完成判定。請注意最後兩條的性質 —— **它們規定的是「什麼時候要停下來」**。安全類技能最重要的不是它會做什麼，是它知道什麼時候不該做。This prompt differs from TEL5's in emphasis. TEL5 cared about not competing with other skills; this one cares about not overreaching. All four red lines **restrict its freedom** rather than extend its capability: any aircraft damage grades at C or above, the 90-day same-tail check is mandatory, insufficient information escalates to the duty manager, and a missing tail number blocks any verdict at all. Note the character of the last two — **they specify when to stop**. For a safety skill, what matters most is not what it can do but knowing when it should not.

提示詞Prompt
請幫我建立一個自訂技能：機坪安全事件分級與通報。當我提供機坪或地面作業安全事件內容並要求判定分級或草擬通報時使用。規則依 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/航空業/AIR3_機坪安全 底下的分級與通報 SOP 撰寫。這個技能涉及飛航安全，請特別強化安全紅線：只要航機有任何實體損傷一律 C 級起跳，不得因描述輕微或無人受傷而降判；必查同機尾號近 90 天件數，達 3 件一律升 B 級；資訊不足時一律升級給值班安全主管，不得自行猜測較低等級；機尾號缺漏時不得完成判定。另外請寫進 scope 邊界：只處理地面機坪事件，飛航中事件與組員飛時問題要指名由其他技能接手。Please create a custom skill: ramp safety occurrence classification and notification, for when I supply a ground or apron occurrence and ask for a grade or a drafted notification. Base the rules on the grading and notification SOP under Cowork_Lab/Aviation/AIR3_Ramp_Safety in OneDrive. This skill touches flight safety, so strengthen the red lines: any physical damage to the aircraft grades at C or above and must never be downgraded because the description sounds minor or nobody was hurt; the 90-day same-tail-number count must always be queried, with three or more escalating to B; insufficient information must always escalate to the duty safety manager rather than guessing a lower grade; and a missing tail number must block completion of the assessment. Also write in scope boundaries: ground and apron occurrences only, with in-flight occurrences and crew flight-time questions handed off to other skills by name.
2

⭐ 它自己補了一條紅線：查不到不等於沒有⭐ It added a red line of its own: "not found" is not "none"

實測拿到 **89 分（Excellent）**，四條紅線都完整寫入。但最值得看的是**它自己加的第五條**，我們沒有要求：**「歷史查詢失敗不得以『查不到＝沒有』推定」。**這條補得非常關鍵。想像一下：如果事件紀錄檔案暫時讀不到，而技能把「查詢失敗」當成「近 90 天 0 件」，那麼一架已經出過三次事的飛機就會被判成 C 級而不是 B 級 —— 而且整份通報看起來完全正常，沒有任何地方顯示它其實沒查到。**這是安全情境裡最典型的推理漏洞：把「沒有證據」誤讀成「證據顯示沒有」。**這一步請帶學員讀完整份技能報告，並特別注意它在「範圍界線」與「穩健度」兩個面向的得分理由。It scored **89 (Excellent)**, with all four red lines written in. The instructive part is **the fifth one it added unprompted**: **a failed history query must never be treated as "none found".** That addition matters more than it first appears. Suppose the occurrence log is temporarily unreadable and the skill records "query failed" as "zero in 90 days" — an aircraft with three prior events is graded C instead of B, and the notification reads perfectly normally, with nothing anywhere indicating that the check never actually happened. **This is the classic reasoning failure in safety work: reading "no evidence" as "evidence of none".** Have learners read the full Skill Report here, paying particular attention to the reasoning behind the scope-boundaries and robustness scores.

3

scope 邊界要指名接手，不能只寫「不處理」Scope boundaries must name a successor, not just decline

這個技能的 scope 邊界寫得很完整，值得對照學習：飛航中事件、空中鳥擊 → 指名交由飛安調查技能；組員飛時與班表合規 → 指名交由組員飛時管理技能。而最好的一條是處理**跨界事件**的規則：「跨地空事件只判地面段，並標註空中段須由飛安調查接手」。這條解決了實務上最麻煩的情況 —— 一件事同時橫跨兩個技能的範圍時，技能不該全做（越權），也不該全不做（沒人接手），而是**做自己該做的那一段，並明確說明剩下的該給誰**。⚠️ 另外提醒：初評分數偏低時多半不是技能寫得不好，而是防護條款只寫了中文 —— 評分會比對 never／always／confirm 這類英文語彙，補上英文語彙就會反映真實品質。The scope boundaries here are worth studying as a model: in-flight occurrences and bird strikes hand off to a flight-safety investigation skill by name; crew flight-time and roster compliance hand off to a crew FTL skill by name. The best clause covers **occurrences that straddle both**: handle only the ground segment and note that the airborne segment must go to flight-safety investigation. That resolves the most awkward real-world case — when something spans two skills' territory, the skill should neither do all of it (overreach) nor none of it (nobody picks it up), but **handle its own segment and say explicitly who takes the rest**. ⚠️ One more note: a low initial score usually does not mean the skill is badly written, but that the guardrails exist only in Chinese — the scoring matches English vocabulary such as never, always and confirm, and adding that phrasing lets the score reflect the actual quality.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

建立技能會跳出「複製檔案」核准卡，沒按核准技能就不會發布 —— 這一點和 TEL5 相同。但安全類技能有一層額外責任值得強調：官方文件明確寫「使用者自建的技能不經 Microsoft 驗證」，而這個技能判定的是**要不要通報主管機關**。因此發布前務必自己跑過幾個邊界案例：沒有機尾號會怎樣、事件紀錄讀不到會怎樣、描述含糊不清會怎樣 —— 確認它在這些情況下會停下來問人，而不是給一個看起來合理的答案。Creating the skill raises a "copy files" approval card, and without approval nothing is published — same as TEL5. But a safety skill carries an extra responsibility worth stressing: the documentation states plainly that user-created skills are not validated by Microsoft, and this one decides **whether an occurrence gets reported to the regulator**. So run the boundary cases yourself before publishing: what happens with no tail number, what happens when the occurrence log cannot be read, what happens when the description is ambiguous — and confirm that in each case it stops and asks rather than producing a plausible-looking answer.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • SKILL.md 有 YAML frontmatter，name 與 description 兩個欄位都存在The SKILL.md has YAML frontmatter with both name and description
  • 「航機有損傷一律 C 級起跳、不得降判」有明確寫進技能The rule that any aircraft damage grades at C or above and cannot be downgraded is written in explicitly
  • 「必查同機尾號近 90 天，即使 0 件也要寫出」有明確寫進技能The mandatory 90-day same-tail check, stated even when zero, is written in explicitly
  • 資訊不足時的處理規定是「升級給值班主管」而非自行猜測The insufficient-information rule escalates to the duty manager rather than guessing
  • 機尾號缺漏時技能會停止判定，而不是給出暫定等級A missing tail number halts the assessment rather than yielding a provisional grade
  • ⭐ 含「歷史查詢失敗不得推定為 0 件」這類拒絕以缺漏當結論的條款⭐ A clause exists forbidding a failed history query from being treated as a zero result
  • scope 邊界每一條都指名接手的技能，並處理跨界事件的情況Every scope boundary names a successor skill, including how to handle cases that straddle two
  • 「複製檔案」核准卡已按下核准，技能確實出現在技能清單中The "copy files" approval card was approved and the skill appears in the skills list

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 故意提供一則沒有機尾號的事件，確認它真的會停下來要求補件。Deliberately supply an occurrence with no tail number and confirm it genuinely stops and asks.
  • 丟一件同時涉及飛航中與地面的事件，看它會不會只判地面段。Supply an occurrence spanning both in-flight and ground phases and see whether it handles only the ground segment.
  • 把 AIR2 的飛時檢查也做成技能，測試兩個技能的邊界會不會互相干擾。Turn AIR2's FTL check into a skill as well and test whether the two boundaries interfere.
